parsed.public_message: Blue (Seleucids) ratifies the four-way truce through t=300 s (turn 12) with one turn of public notice before any change. We will set neutral toward all three of you on Turn 1, hold West Plateau peacefully, and advance along the western approach as the ring contracts. Any truce-breaker faces the rest of us together.

private_messages.Claude: Agreed on the t=300s truce and one-turn notice. For boundaries: I will stay west of x=480 as the ring shrinks while you hold Little Hill. Note the draft math: Grok paid 800 (only 3200 army budget on Central Heights), while GPT paid 0 for River Ford (full 4000 budget on low ground right between you and Grok). Let's stay aligned and coordinate our target as t=300s approaches.
private_messages.Grok: Truce confirmed through t=300s; I will set neutral on Turn 1. I am on West Plateau and will keep to the western/southwestern approach so we don't crowd Central Heights. Keep in mind both GPT (River Ford) and Claude (Little Hill) paid 0 for their regions and field full 4000-point armies right on your southeastern flank.
private_messages.GPT: Blue accepts your reciprocal truce through t=300s and will set neutral on Turn 1. Since I am far west on West Plateau and you are east at River Ford, we have natural separation and zero border friction. Let's keep peaceful passage intact while watching the two central hills.

parsed.notes_to_self: Budgets: Us 4000 (West Plateau), Claude 4000 (Little Hill), GPT 4000 (River Ford), Grok 3200 (Central Heights, paid 800). Army (4000 pts, 34 units + Seleucus I): 4 Elephants total (Seleucus I + 3 Armored Elephants with Zooiarchos +20% atk/+20% speed -> 10.8 m/s, immune to anti-cav bonus, massive splash), 12 Thracian Swordsmen (Advanced, 140.8 Hack DPS), 7 Companion Cav (Advanced, 18 m/s, 1.75x vs Cav), 10 Syrian Archers (Advanced, 60m), 2 Surgeons (heal Elephants/Hero). Turn 1: set neutral to all, keep Seleucus I + elephants + surgeons + swordsmen together, begin descending east around t=175-200s before ring hits West Plateau at t=289s.
parsed.explanation: Having secured West Plateau for zero points, we spend our full 4000-point budget on a Seleucid combined-arms juggernaut anchored by Seleucus I and three Armored War Elephants, whose Zooiarchos aura boosts the elephants to 10.8 m/s speed and +20% splash damage while taking zero bonus damage from anti-cavalry pikemen. Supporting the four elephants are two Surgeons to sustain their massive health pools and 29 Advanced-rank mercenaries—12 high-DPS Thracian Swordsmen, 10 Syrian Archers, and 7 fast Companion Cavalry to hunt enemy cavalry and ranged backlines.
